description: This file contains unit tests for the IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader class, which is part of the HTTP headers utilities related to conditional headers in the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests verify immutability, header key and value retrieval, condition checking with EntityTags, handling of special '*' condition, and integration with DittoHeaders objects.

classes.name: IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeaderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader, including immutability, key/value retrieval, condition evaluation with EntityTags, and integration with DittoHeaders.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader class is immutable.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Tests that the header key returned is 'if-none-match'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Tests that the header value is correctly retrieved and matches the set EntityTag.

methods.name: doesNotMeetConditionForEqualOpaqueTag
methods.description: Ensures that matching opaque EntityTags with the condition returns false.

methods.name: meetsConditionForNull
methods.description: Checks that the condition is met when the EntityTag is null.

methods.name: asteriskMeetsConditionForNull
methods.description: Verifies that '*' in the header meets the condition when EntityTag is null.

methods.name: asteriskDoesNotMeetConditionForNonNull
methods.description: Ensures that '*' does not meet the condition when a non-null EntityTag is provided.

methods.name: ListMeetsConditionIfNotContained
methods.description: Checks that the condition is met if an EntityTag is not contained in the list.

methods.name: ListDoesNotMeetConditionIfContained
methods.description: Verifies that the condition is not met if the EntityTag is contained in the list.

methods.name: fromDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests creating IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader from DittoHeaders object where the header is set.
